message.content:
Below is a **general overview** of the most common “long‑weekend” holidays that Canadians typically enjoy in 2023.  
(Keep in mind that some holidays are province‑specific, so the exact dates may differ slightly depending on where you live.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Typical Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|---------------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday, Jan 1 | **Jan 1–3** (Sunday–Tuesday) | Since it falls on a Sunday, the public holiday is observed on Monday, Jan 2. |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, BC, Ontario, Saskatchewan) | Monday, Feb 20 | **Feb 18–20** (Saturday–Monday) | Observed only in those provinces. |
| **Good Friday** | Friday, Apr 7 | **Apr 7–9** (Friday–Sunday) | Public holiday in all provinces. |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | **May 20–22** (Saturday–Monday) | Public holiday in all provinces. |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday, Jul 1 | **Jul 1–3** (Saturday–Monday) | Public holiday in all provinces. |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, Sep 4 | **Sep 2–4** (Saturday–Monday) | Public holiday in all provinces. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, Oct 9 | **Oct 7–9** (Saturday–Monday) | Public holiday in all provinces. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Wednesday, Nov 11 | *Not a long weekend* | Public holiday in all provinces, but falls mid‑week. |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday, Dec 25 | **Dec 23–25** (Saturday–Monday) | Public holiday in all provinces. |

### How to Use This List in Your App
1. **Create a calendar view** that highlights the above dates.  
2. **Add a toggle** for province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day).  
3. **Provide optional reminders** a week before each long weekend so users can plan trips in advance.

If you need the exact dates for a specific province or want to include additional holidays (e.g., *St. Patrick’s Day* in Newfoundland & Labrador, *St. John’s Day* in Prince Edward Island), let me know and I can expand the table accordingly!
